Now, as we look ahead to Avatar: Fire and Ash, we revisit the song that first connected us to Pandora.
An exclusive glimpse — celebrating the legacy before the next chapter begins.
When Avatar changed cinema forever, Leona Lewis’ “I See You” carried its soul.
Over a decade later, To celebrate the emotion that still echoes — just in time for Avatar: Fire and Ash.
A rare moment, an exclusive vision, one world reunited.
